final_topology.title: Government Data Center Topology
final_topology.description: A secure and compliant data center design with isolated zones for public services, development, and production systems.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a DMZ for public-facing services, isolated zones for development and production, and a disaster recovery site. All network activity is logged for compliance.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n23) that manages and connects to various nodes and routers, indicating a detailed asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n24) that manages and connects to various nodes and routers, indicating documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for DMZ, Development, Production, and Disaster Recovery, indicating proper segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n1) and a 'Web Application Firewall' (n2) in the DMZ, indicating firewalls are implemented and managed.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n14) and a 'DNS Filter' (n15) in the Management Zone, indicating trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Node' (n17) and a 'Centralized AAA Server' (n20) in the Management Zone, indicating MFA is required for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n15) in the Security Zone, indicating DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n16) and a 'DNS Filter' (n15) in the Security Zone, indicating network-based URL filters are enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for DMZ, Development, Production, and Disaster Recovery, and various security nodes, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes 'Version-Controlled IaC' (n25) and 'Secure Network Protocols' (n26) in the Management Zone, indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Centralized AAA Server' (n20) in the Management Zone, indicating centralized AAA is implemented.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Gateway' (n27) and a 'Remote Device' (n28) in the Remote Access Zone, and the 'Remote Device' is connected to the 'Centralized AAA Server' (n20), indicating remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' (n13) in the Security Zone, indicating a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes zone links between DMZ, Development, Production, and Disaster Recovery, with labeled uplinks indicating traffic filtering between segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control Policy' (n29) in the Remote Access Zone, indicating access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Flow Log Collector' (n_new1) in the Management Zone, which collects logs from various routers, indicating network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for Development and Production, indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Node' (n22) in the External Testing Zone and a 'Pen Test Schedule' (n30) in the same zone, indicating periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes links and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes routers, firewalls, and other network devices, but there is no explicit evidence of secure management practices such as version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes or labels indicating secure management practices such as version-controlled IaC and secure network protocols.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Centralized AAA Server (n20) and a dedicated admin workstation (n21), but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links to remote devices and the Centralized AAA Server.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an MFA/Identity node (n17) and a Centralized AAA Server (n20), but there is no explicit evidence of access control for remote assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control for remote assets.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes or labels indicating access control policies for remote assets.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Penetration Testing Node (n22) in the External Testing Zone, but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating the frequency and scope of external penetration tests.
